features.name: Otherworldly Patron
features.description: Choose an Otherworldly Patron that grants you features at 1st, 6th, 10th, and 14th level.

features.name: Pact Magic
features.description: You have a small number of spell slots that all recharge on a short rest. You cast all your warlock spells of 1st level and higher using these slots at the same spell level (your pact magic slot level increases with level). You know warlock spells and cantrips; your spellcasting ability is Charisma.

features.name: Eldritch Invocations
features.description: You learn eldritch invocations of your choice. You learn additional invocations at higher warlock levels. Some invocations have prerequisites.

features.name: Pact Boon
features.description: Choose Pact of the Chain, Pact of the Blade, or Pact of the Tome, each granting a distinct benefit tied to your pact.

features.name: Mystic Arcanum
features.description: You can cast each of the following once per long rest without expending a spell slot: one 6th-level spell at 11th level, one 7th-level spell at 13th level, one 8th-level spell at 15th level, and one 9th-level spell at 17th level. Each is drawn from the warlock spell list.

features.name: Eldritch Master
features.description: You can spend 1 minute entreating your patron for aid to regain all expended spell slots from your Pact Magic feature. Once you regain spell slots with this feature, you must finish a long rest before you can do so again.

subclasses.name: The Archfey
subclasses.description: Your patron is a lord or lady of the fey, a creature of legend who holds secrets that were forgotten before mortal races walked the earth.

features.name: Fey Presence
features.description: As an action, you can cause each creature in a 10-foot cube originating from you to make a Wisdom saving throw against your warlock spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature is charmed or frightened by you (your choice) until the end of your next turn. Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

features.name: Misty Escape
features.description: When you are hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to turn invisible and teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You remain invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack or cast a spell. Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

features.name: Beguiling Defenses
features.description: You are immune to being charmed, and when another creature attempts to charm you, you can use your reaction to attempt to turn the charm back on that creature. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your warlock spell save DC or be charmed by you for 1 minute or until the creature takes damage.

features.name: Dark Delirium
features.description: As an action, you can choose one visible creature within 60 feet. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your warlock spell save DC or be charmed or frightened by you (your choice) for 1 minute. The effect ends early if you are incapacitated, die, or use this feature again. Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

subclasses.name: The Fiend
subclasses.description: You have made a pact with a fiend from the lower planes, a being whose aims are evil and who seeks to corrupt and destroy all that is good.

features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.description: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier + your warlock level.

features.name: Dark One's Own Luck
features.description: You can call on your patron to alter fate. When you make an ability check or a saving throw, you can use this feature to add 1d10 to your roll. You can do so after seeing the roll but before any of the roll's effects occur. Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

features.name: Fiendish Resilience
features.description: Whenever you finish a short or long rest, choose one damage type. You gain resistance to that damage type until you choose a different one with this feature.

features.name: Hurl Through Hell
features.description: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can use this feature to instantly transport the target through the lower planes. The creature disappears and hurtles through a nightmare landscape, taking 10d10 psychic damage if it is not a fiend. It reappears at the end of your next turn in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space. Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest.

subclasses.name: The Great Old One
subclasses.description: Your patron is an inscrutable entity from the Far Realm, or a being whose aims are utterly alien and whose knowledge of the universe is unfathomable.

features.name: Awakened Mind
features.description: You can telepathically speak to any creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The creature understands you only if it knows at least one language.

features.name: Entropic Ward
features.description: When a creature makes an attack roll against you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on that roll. If the attack misses, you can use your reaction on your next turn to give yourself advantage on one attack roll against that creature.

features.name: Thought Shield
features.description: Your thoughts cannot be read by telepathy or similar means unless you allow it. You also have resistance to psychic damage, and whenever a creature deals psychic damage to you, that creature takes the same amount of psychic damage.

features.name: Create Thrall
features.description: You can use magic to charm a humanoid that is incapacitated. The target remains charmed until you die, you use this feature on a different target, or you take an action to dismiss the effect. The charmed target is friendly to you and your companions and obeys your verbal commands. The target cannot be charmed by you again in this way.
